sourceRefs.locator: Chapter 2, pp. 7–13, property boundaries, plot and house layouts, fifteen building levels; chapter 4, p. 38, Level 4, FS 20 (Plot 2, amber) and FS 18 (Plot 5, writing tablet, carved head, coin of Eadred); p. 82 for Level 4 as mid-tenth century. Fig. 9, p. 36, grid on Plot 3, used to orient the Fishamble Street excavation area.
Excavations 1976:047, habitation area inside the banks, amber fragments and unfinished beads and pendants. These finds illustrate working at Fishamble Street more generally.

Collection overview, paragraphs on wooden pathways and property boundaries, reused ship timbers in dock walls, drains and paths; the Fishamble Street amber worker’s floor with several hundred flakes and splinters.

labels.de: Eine Werkstatt in der Fishamble Street

note.de: Bernsteinreste deuten auf eine Werkstatt in Haus FS 20 auf Grundstück 2. Eine Münze hilft bei der Datierung der vierten Bauphase um die Mitte des zehnten Jahrhunderts. Die Karte zeigt das Grabungsareal.
note.en: Amber debris suggests a workshop in house FS 20 on Plot 2. A coin helps date the fourth building phase to around the middle of the tenth century. The map marks the excavation area.
